study_name: BIG IDEAs Lab Glycemic Variability and Wearable Device Data
treatment_modalities: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM), Wearable Physiological Monitoring, Digital Biomarker Engineering, Standardized Meal Testing, Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT)
study_description: Dataset of 16 participants with elevated but non-diabetic glucose levels monitored for 8-10 days using Dexcom G6 CGM and Empatica E4 wearable devices to generate digital biomarkers for glycemic variability and prediabetes risk detection.
